_readme: Hand-labelled ground truth for the M7 Phase 0 spike. One entry per CLIP (so a swing
recorded from two angles appears twice, labelled INDEPENDENTLY — the matched pair is
the control that makes the down-the-line question answerable at all).
Label from the index-burned frame dump:
truth_top    = the last frame before the hands begin to descend
truth_impact = the first frame in which the ball is no longer at rest
label_uncertainty_frames: how many frames either way you would accept. +/-1 for impact
at 60fps is normal (the ball travels ~74 cm between frames at 100 mph). No verdict may
rest on a margin smaller than this — record it honestly, it is what keeps the findings
angle must be exactly 'face_on' or 'down_the_line'; the scorer groups on it.
keypoints paths are relative to this file.
Delete the _example entry before the real run.

clips.note: PLUMBING SMOKE TEST ONLY — these numbers are copied from the detector, not hand-labelled. They must score exactly 0.0 error for lead_wrist; anything else means the clip/label join is broken. Delete this entry before the real run.
